info.title: StockFlow Inventory & Warehouse API
info.description: HTTP contract for authentication, core master data, fulfillment, and stock opname workflows. Authenticated write requests require an Idempotency-Key header; identical retries replay the saved response. Authenticated requests use the HttpOnly stockflow_session cookie and CSRF header for writes.

200.description: Session created; token is set in an HttpOnly cookie

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Required for authenticated writes. Identical retries return the first response. Reusing a key with a different request returns 409.

Forbidden.description: Permission, CSRF, or warehouse scope denied the request

Conflict.description: Current workflow state or idempotency key conflicts with this request
